#49 Added a section on torsors in homotopy type theory, including the univalent moduli type of left torsors, its delooping properties, and the general path-torsor characterization. The section also points to a machine-checked Cubical Agda formalization and distinguishes the precise hypotheses and universe levels of the verified results.

Hongwei Wang
